# Focus — Campus Event Photography

> Focus is a student-run photography studio documenting university and campus events across India — cultural fests, convocations, hackathons, sports weeks, TEDx talks and theatre nights — delivered as hand-edited, numbered albums.

Every event becomes a numbered album, hand-edited and sequenced, delivered to the organising club as a private gallery. Packages range from a single club night to full-academic-year yearbook coverage.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the studio, featured shoots, albums, packages and booking.
- [Featured shoots](/#featured): Recent campus shoots — fests, convocations, hackathons, sports, TEDx, theatre.
- [Albums](/#albums): The archive of numbered albums, kept by semester.
- [Yearbook](/#yearbook): What student organisers say about working with Focus.
- [Packages](/#packages): Pricing tiers — Club Night, Fest Weekend and The Yearbook.
- [Journal](/#journal): Field notes and playbooks for campus clubs shooting their own events.
- [Booking](/#booking): Reserve coverage for a campus event.
